categories.name: secrets
categories.description: API keys, private keys, credentials, and high-entropy tokens that look like authentication material.

categories.name: pii
categories.description: Email addresses, phone numbers, and government identifiers. Replaced with policy-defined placeholder token IDs in the output stream.

categories.name: hate
categories.description: Hate speech directed at protected classes.

categories.name: jailbreak
categories.description: Known prompt-injection / role-escape patterns. Generation rewinds and resamples with the offending tokens masked.

categories.name: violence
categories.description: Graphic violence. Generation continues; downstream consumers receive an annotation in the policy_violation telemetry channel.
